arxiv-2111-12704.title: Investigating Tradeoffs in Real-World Video Super-Resolution
arxiv-2111-12704.creator: Kelvin C.K. Chan, Shangchen Zhou, Xiangyu Xu, Chen Change Loy
arxiv-2111-12704.description: Abstract The diversity and complexity of degradations in real-world video super-resolution (VSR) pose non-trivial challenges in inference and training. First, while long-term propagation leads to improved performance in cases of mild degradations, severe in-the-wild degradations could be exaggerated through propagation, impairing output quality.

arxiv-2201-06046.title: Extensions and congruences of partial lattices
arxiv-2201-06046.creator: Ivan Chajda, Helmut Länger
arxiv-2201-06046.description: Abstract For a partial lattice 𝐋 \mathbf{L} the so-called two-point extension is defined in order to extend 𝐋 \mathbf{L} to a lattice. We are motivated by the fact that the one-point extension broadly used for partial algebras does not work in this case, i.e. the one-point extension of a partial lattice need not be a lattice.

arxiv-2210-06196.title: On the Preservation of Properties when Changing Communication Models Thanks: This work was carried out as part of the VOICE-B project, which is funded by Canon Production Printing.
arxiv-2210-06196.creator: Olav Bunte, Louis C.M. van Gool, Tim A.C. Willemse
arxiv-2210-06196.description: Abstract In a system of processes that communicate asynchronously by means of FIFO channels, there are many options in which these channels can be laid out. In this paper, we compare channel layouts in how they affect the behaviour of the system using an ordering based on splitting and merging channels.

arxiv-2301-07237.title: Designing two-dimensional limit-cycle oscillators with prescribed trajectories and phase-response characteristics
arxiv-2301-07237.creator: Norihisa Namura, Tsubasa Ishii, Hiroya Nakao
arxiv-2301-07237.description: Abstract We propose a method for designing two-dimensional limit-cycle oscillators with prescribed periodic trajectories and phase response properties based on the phase reduction theory, which gives a concise description of weakly-perturbed limit-cycle oscillators and is widely used in the analysis of synchronization dynamics.

arxiv-2310-11553.title: NuSTAR and XMM-Newton observations of the binary 4FGL J1405.1-6119
arxiv-2310-11553.creator: Enzo A. Saavedra, Federico A. Fogantini, Gastón J. Escobar, Gustavo E. Romero, Jorge A. Combi, Estefania Marcel
arxiv-2310-11553.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Enzo A. Saavedra, Federico A. Fogantini, Gastón J. Escobar, Gustavo E. Romero, Jorge A. Combi, Estefania Marcel. 4FGL J1405.1-6119 is a high-mass γ \gamma -ray-emitting binary that has been studied at several wavelengths. The nature of this type of binary is still under debate, with three possible scenarios usually invoked to explain the origin of the γ \gamma -ray emission: collisions between the winds of a rapidly rotating neutron star and its companion, collisions between the winds of two massive stars, and nonthermal emission

arxiv-2408-01466.title: Mittag-Leffler Poisson Distribution Series and Their Application to Univalent Functions
arxiv-2408-01466.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by . In this study, we establish a significant connection between certain subclasses of complex order univalent functions and the Mittag-Leffler-type Poisson distribution series. We provide criteria for these series to belong to the specific subclasses.

arxiv-2411-12019.title: Regret-Free Reinforcement Learning for Temporal Logic Specifications
arxiv-2411-12019.creator: Rupak Majumdar, Mahmoud Salamati, Sadegh Soudjani
arxiv-2411-12019.description: Abstract Learning to control an unknown dynamical system with respect to high-level temporal specifications is an important problem in control theory. We present the first regret-free online algorithm for learning a controller for linear temporal logic (LTL) specifications for systems with unknown dynamics.

arxiv-2412-10582.title: WHAT-IF: Exploring Branching Narratives by Meta-Prompting Large Language Models
arxiv-2412-10582.creator: Runsheng "Anson" Huang, Lara J. Martin, Chris Callison-Burch
arxiv-2412-10582.description: Abstract WHAT-IF — W riting a H ero’s A lternate T imeline through I nteractive F iction—is a system that uses zero-shot meta-prompting to create branching narratives from a prewritten story. Played as an interactive fiction (IF) game, WHAT-IF lets the player choose between decisions that the large language model (LLM) GPT-4 generates as possible branches in the story.

arxiv-2505-17612.title: Distilling LLM Agent into Small Models with Retrieval and Code Tools
arxiv-2505-17612.creator: Minki Kang, Jongwon Jeong *, Seanie Lee, Jaewoong Cho, Sung Ju Hwang
arxiv-2505-17612.description: Abstract Large language models (LLMs) excel at complex reasoning tasks but remain computationally expensive, limiting their practical deployment. To address this, recent works have focused on distilling reasoning capabilities into smaller language models (sLMs) using chain-of-thought (CoT) traces from teacher LLMs.

arxiv-2506-01986.title: SpecMemo: Speculative Decoding is in Your Pocket
arxiv-2506-01986.creator: Selin Yildirim Deming Chen
arxiv-2506-01986.description: Abstract Recent advancements in speculative decoding have demonstrated considerable speedup across a wide array of large language model (LLM) tasks. Speculative decoding inherently relies on sacrificing extra memory allocations to generate several candidate tokens, of which acceptance rate drives the speedup. However, deploying speculative decoding on memory-constrained devices, such as mobile GPUs, remains as a significant challenge in real-world scenarios.

arxiv-2506-23551.title: A unified framework on the universal approximation of transformer-type architectures
arxiv-2506-23551.creator: Jingpu Cheng, Ting Lin, Qianxiao Li, Zuowei Shen
arxiv-2506-23551.description: Abstract We investigate the universal approximation property (UAP) of transformer-type architectures, providing a unified theoretical framework that extends prior results on residual networks to models incorporating attention mechanisms. Our work identifies token distinguishability as a fundamental requirement for UAP and introduces a general sufficient condition that applies to a broad class of architectures.

arxiv-2507-01886.title: Improving GANs by leveraging the quantum noise from real hardware
arxiv-2507-01886.creator: Hongni Jin, Kenneth M. Merz, Jr
arxiv-2507-01886.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Hongni Jin, Kenneth M. Merz, Jr. We propose a novel approach to generative adversarial networks (GANs) in which the standard i.i.d. Gaussian latent prior is replaced or hybridized with a quantum-correlated prior derived from measurements of a 16-qubit entangling circuit.

arxiv-2507-16756.title: Efficient Bayesian Inference for Discretely Observed Continuous Time Markov Chains
arxiv-2507-16756.creator: Tao Tang, Lachlan Astfalck, David Dunson
arxiv-2507-16756.description: Abstract Inference for continuous-time Markov chains (CTMCs) becomes challenging when the process is only observed at discrete time points. The exact likelihood is intractable, and existing methods often struggle even in medium-dimensional state-spaces. We propose a scalable Bayesian framework for CTMC inference based on a pseudo-likelihood that bypasses the need for the full intractable likelihood.

arxiv-2601-22516.title: SCOPE-PD: Explainable AI on Subjective and Clinical Objective Measurements of Parkinson’s Disease for Precision Decision-Making
arxiv-2601-22516.creator: Md Mezbahul Islam, John Michael Templeton, Masrur Sobhan, Christian Poellabauer, Ananda Mohan Mondal
arxiv-2601-22516.description: Abstract Parkinson’s disease (PD) is a chronic and complex neurodegenerative disorder influenced by genetic, clinical, and lifestyle factors. Predicting this disease early is challenging because it depends on traditional diagnostic methods that face issues of subjectivity, which commonly delay diagnosis.

collectanea-chymica-a-collection-of-ten-.title: Collectanea chymica : a collection of ten several treatises in chymistry : concerning the liquor alkahest, the mercury of philosophers, and other curiosities worthy the perusal
collectanea-chymica-a-collection-of-ten-.creator: Philalethes, Eirenaeus; Cooper, William, fl. 1668-1688

europmc-pmc8012365.title: Connecting structure to function with the recovery of over 1000 high-quality metagenome-assembled genomes from activated sludge using long-read sequencing.
europmc-pmc8012365.creator: Singleton CM, Petriglieri F, Kristensen JM, Kirkegaard RH, Michaelsen TY, Andersen MH, Kondrotaite Z, Karst SM, Dueholm MS, Nielsen PH, Albertsen M.
europmc-pmc8012365.description: Microorganisms play crucial roles in water recycling, pollution removal and resource recovery in the wastewater industry. The structure of these microbial communities is increasingly understood based on 16S rRNA amplicon sequencing data. However, such data cannot be linked to...

pmc-10650264.title: Correction to: Explaining human interactions on the road by large-scale integration of computational psychological theory
pmc-10650264.creator: Unknown

This error has been corrected in the original article.

pmc-11368180.title: A gene regulatory network–aware graph learning method for cell identity annotation in single-cell RNA-seq data
pmc-11368180.creator: Mengyuan Zhao, Jiawei Li, Xiaoyi Liu, Ke Ma, Jijun Tang, Fei Guo
pmc-11368180.description: Cell identity annotation for single-cell transcriptome data is a crucial process for constructing cell atlases, unraveling pathogenesis, and inspiring therapeutic approaches. Currently, the efficacy of existing methodologies is contingent upon specific data sets. Nevertheless, such data are often sourced from various batches, sequencing technologies, tissues, and even species.

pmc-11465555.title: Study on the Suppression of Vitrinite Reflectance: A Thermal Simulation Experiment
pmc-11465555.creator: Hui Zhang, Weibo Zhao, Huaichang Wang, Huijuan Guo, Ping’an Peng
pmc-11465555.description: Vitrinite reflectance is the most widely used parameter for reconstructing the thermal history of sedimentary basins and evaluating the maturation of source rocks. However, suppression of vitrinite reflectance has also been reported, which could affect the accuracy of evaluating the degree of thermal evolution.

pmc-11692036.title: SOCIAL CAPITAL PROFILES AMONG CHINESE OLDER ADULTS: A LATENT CLASS ANALYSIS
pmc-11692036.creator: Yuekang Li, Nancy Morrow-Howell
pmc-11692036.description: Existing literature often overlooks the multifaceted social engagements of older adults, neglecting how well-being is intricately influenced by diverse combinations of social capital. This study investigates social capital profiles among Chinese older adults, examining how these profiles vary in relation to demographic characteristics and health outcomes.

pmc-12513965.title: Iloprost therapy achieves good clinical and radiological short and mid-term outcomes in patients with idiopathic aseptic osteonecrosis of the knee joint also in ARCO level II
pmc-12513965.creator: Stephanie Kirschbaum, Carsten Perka, Moses El-Kayali, Clemens Gwinner, Thula Cannon Walter-Rittel, Maurice Soujon, Stefanie Donner
pmc-12513965.description: AimsThe aim of this retrospective study was the evaluation of the patient-reported and radiological outcome of intravenous Iloprost therapy in the treatment of spontaneous osteonecrosis of the knee (SONK).Methods36 patients (age 57.3 ± 8.7 years, 38.9% women, 61.1% men) who received Iloprost between 2018 and 2021 due to SONK (ARCO I and II) were included in this retrospective cohort study.

pmc-12548266.title: Lake sturgeon behavioral diversity in the Laurentian great lakes: migratory patterns across populations and habitats
pmc-12548266.creator: Skye D Fissette, Charles C Krueger, Lisa M O’Connor, Thomas C Pratt, Daniel A Isermann, Dan Wilfond, John A Sweka, Darryl W Hondorp
pmc-12548266.description: BackgroundCharacterizing the diversity of migration behaviors from the individual to the population level is essential for understanding how organisms respond to environmental variation and how these responses affect survival and habitat use. Lake sturgeon (Acipenser fulvescens) is a species of special concern in the Laurentian Great Lakes that are long-lived and generally classified as intermittent, adfluvial spawners.

pmc-12577127.title: Urinary fluoride and dental fluorosis in relation to kidney and liver function in adolescents and young adults in the United States
pmc-12577127.creator: Durdana Khan, Alexandra Mattia, Zhilin Wang, Ashley J Malin
pmc-12577127.description: BackgroundHigher fluoride in plasma has been associated with lower eGFR among adolescents in the National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey (NHANES); however, whether fluoride exposure may contribute to decreased kidney function or fluoride may accumulate in plasma from lower kidney filtration could not be parsed.

pmc-12740457.title: Multiple Myeloma and Secondary Immunodeficiency: A Retrospective Database Analysis Assessing Burden of Infection and Treatment Patterns
pmc-12740457.creator: Csaba Siffel, Matthew S Davids, Colin Anderson-Smits, Marta Kamieniak, Kaili Ren, Shirin Ardeshir-Rouhani-Fard, Drishti Shah, Joshua Richter, Kalyani Sen
pmc-12740457.description: Patients with multiple myeloma (MM) and secondary immunodeficiency (SID) are at risk of infection‐related morbidity and mortality owing to the disease process and treatment toxicity. This retrospective cohort study used anonymized data from the Optum‐Humedica database (October 2015–March 2020) to assess the burden of infection in patients with MM and SID versus patients without SID.

pmc-13416205.title: The Role of Malnutrition, Nutritional Deficiencies and Eating Disorders in Patients with Takotsubo Syndrome—Scoping Review
pmc-13416205.creator: Dominika Wiśniewska, Martyna Winiarska, Sabina Krupa-Nurcek
pmc-13416205.description: Objectives: Takotsubo syndrome (TTS) is an acute, often reversible disorder of left ventricular systolic function, the pathophysiology of which is complex and still being studied. A growing body of clinical research indicates that patients’ nutritional status may substantially influence the development and trajectory of Takotsubo syndrome.
